results.rationale: Forward-delivery technical methodology can be credibly provided based on our prior network design and civil/bridge engineering deployments relevant to fibre ducting and integration activities.
A CPM-based 18‑month work programme with civil-works contingencies is a delivery commitment supported by our road/bridge execution experience and PMP-led planning capability.

We can evidence availability of PEC-registered engineers, but the profile does not explicitly confirm a Project Manager who is both PEC-registered and has 15+ years’ experience, nor does it explicitly evidence the Civil Works Lead and Network/Security Lead credentials.
We can commit to proposing a platform and architecture, but existing evidence is adjacent (cybersecurity/cloud) and does not specifically demonstrate prior face/LPR video-analytics platform delivery.
An HSE management system for live-road civil works (including traffic management planning) is credibly supported by our documented HSE policy and prior road-construction deployments.
Procedural commitment — complied with in the submission.
